decisions.reason: The illuminated sound arch was featured on the home page through 2019 and is cheap to keep in a made-to-order craft catalog, so there is no evidence yet that justifies dropping it.
A one-tier pyramid is a core seasonal item that costs little to keep in the range and fits the firm's established business, so keeping the option open is sensible.
As the firm's flagship platform with interchangeable discs, it anchors a series of follow-on options and its value is still unfolding, so it should be kept.
The second edition in 2019 signals enough demand to extend the line, and motif platforms cost little to keep, although later editions may eventually replace it.
This Christmas motif sells every season at low carrying cost and supports the music box system, so keeping it preserves the upside.
The Dresden-themed pyramid has regional collector appeal and was prominently shown, and nothing in the results points to abandoning it.
